title: MV Retaining equipment with an empty party causes an error (item.object is not a function)

posts.author: ZoeZero
Robro33
posts.body:
ZoeZero said:
So, when I remove a member from the party temporarily and this member returns later, their equipment is still with them (this can't seem to be done without this script)
Click to expand...
ZoeZero said:
Is there an existing plugin that prevents equipment removal on member removal?
Click to expand...
By default, any actor that leaves the party keeps their gear with them and still has it when they return unless you have the initialize checkbox checked when re-adding them. if actors leave and their gear is being removed from them, either you have a plugin doing it or youre reinitializing them

It's probably a plugin, then. I'll take a look at them.
What happens to me is that some battles in my game are 1v1. Then I remove the party and add them back later. When that happens, players (and I, too, when testing) have reported having all the equipment returned to the inventory and having to re-equip it. The members aren't reinitialized, I've double-checked that. All the equipment is constantly removed and this is the cause that seemed most logical to me. So far, I haven't noticed it happen again after adding this script, but now it has caused this new error when the party is empty. Perhaps another plugin is involved. Thanks for pointing that out.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
1) the equipment behaviour is not default, so something already has changed the engine.
Please check the order of your Yanfly plugins against his main list, I'm pretty sure that especially several of the ones lower on your list are in the wrong order.
Yanfly's plugins have to be in exactly the order of his main list, top to bottom. you can place other plugins between them where needed for compatibility, but if you mess up Yanfly's order they are known to cause strange behaviour and bugs.
please remember to start a new playtest-game after reordering, older saves will become incompatible.
2) ChatGPT is "famous" for creating nonfunctional, buggy or convoluted plugins.
In fact you need to have a good basic programming knowledge to even guide the bot to create a functional plugin as most results on first try are absolute nonsense.
As a result most programmers here on the forum refuse to bughunt plugins created by that bot (and the few others require you to state the source first, but you already did that).

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Troubleshooting suggestions:
Turn off all plugins (Ctrl+A to select all, right-click -> Turn OFF), save your project to apply Plugin Manager changes, then test from New Game, not from a previous save. If it still happens in that case, then check for
Equip Weapon/Armor
traits: if a trait gets removed (e.g. because it's on a state that gets removed on battle end) then any related equipment will be unequipped.
If it's OK with all plugins turned off, try turning them on in small batches. Save your project each time to apply Plugin Manager changes before testing. Given the problem, I'd consider starting with YEP_X_EquipRequirements and/or YEP_AutoPassiveStates.
This general approach applies to basically any unidentified problem in a project using plugins. The goal is to simplify the situation as much as possible before attempting to check remaining possible causes.
